relevance_rank_note: Indirect: endosomal distribution of the recycling cell-surface proteoglycan glypican-1 in non-isogenic human APOE4/4 (LOAD donor) vs APOE3/3 fibroblasts; colocalization only, no recycling assay, no ARF6.

description: Glypican-1 (a recycling cell-surface heparan sulfate proteoglycan) colocalized much less with Rab7 late endosomes in APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 human fibroblasts (Pearson R 0.32 vs 0.85); the authors read this as retarded transport from early to late endosomes. No APOE4 vs APOE3 test is reported. Effect detail: the text prints Pearson r for GPC1 with Rab7 of 0.32 in APOE4/4 vs 0.85 in APOE3/3; no test compares the genotypes.
quote: When corresponding co-localizations were determined in ApoE4/4 fibroblasts the Pearson R-values were for Rab5 vs GPC1 G:R = 0.71 (Fig. 4E and F) and for Rab7 vs GPC1 G:R = 0.32; significance ** (Fig. 4G) indicating retarded transport of GPC1 to early endosomes and from early to late endosomes.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4) -> (less glypican-1 in Rab7 late endosomes)
system: Human skin fibroblasts from Coriell: APOE3/3 GM23976 (male, 52 years, healthy) vs APOE4/4 AG10788 (sex unknown, 87 years, late-onset AD), passages 6-15; immunofluorescence of GPC1 with Rab5 or Rab7, Pearson R from six low-magnification images per condition. Non-brain cells; not isogenic; one donor per genotype; APOE4 donor aged with AD.
human_check: Split from the Rab5 row at the team leader's approval (2026-11-19 referee pass). Fig 4 viewed: R printed in merged panels, C (E3) 0.85+/-0.002, G (E4) 0.32+/-0.013. P=0.004 in the legend is panel E vs G (both APOE4/4), not APOE4 vs APOE3, so it is not used. AG10788 is the same Coriell donor as the APOE4 parental line in 33027662 and the APOE4/4 fibroblast line in 29946028.
